payload.rationale: Tampa Bay is the home team and had a much better showing in Week 1, losing a close game 33-27, whereas Cleveland was blown out 34-10. Cleveland is missing a starting guard (Teven Jenkins). Tampa Bay has a few questionable players but no one ruled out. Home-field advantage and Week 1 performance point to Tampa Bay being the favorite. The strongest reason this estimate could be too high is that Cleveland's Week 1 blowout might indicate deep systemic issues, making their true win probability even lower. The strongest reason this estimate could be too low is that Week 1 results can be highly misleading, and Cleveland might be a better team overall than a single game suggests.
limitations: Only one regular-season game has been played by these teams; records and scoring totals are a very small sample.
No opponent-adjusted strength model or final game-day inactive list is supplied. Injury designations can change before kickoff.
